title: feat(studio): pick an object list view from the Interfaces header title, and keep it in the address
body:
Part of #30046 — this PR ships Scope 1–5. Scope 6–8 (fold the `surface=view:` page into this one, the 不在导航中 → 视图 filter, readable form-view names and their 视图类型) are left for a decision: see the size reading in Acceptance notes.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio「界面」里对象入口的标题变成「对象 / 视图 ▾」,用运行态列表同一个下拉切换视图、搜索、新建视图;右侧面板的视图选择器、「添加视图」和「返回…」去掉了;当前视图写进地址栏 `?view=`。
- 为什么改:维护者要求「在预览区域顶部下拉选择视图。在对象的位置」,与前端运行态一致;原来切换视图后标题、地址都不变,刷新就回到默认视图,无法分享链接。
- 风险与回滚:只动 Studio 界面支柱(`ui/packages/app-shell`)与 studio 文案;不改 spec、不改服务端、不改元数据。运行态列表的下拉只多了「📌 可省略」一项,运行态照传,行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ObjectListViewTitle.tsx`(新标题与新建视图)、`ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` 中 `useObjectListViewDraft` 的 `initialView` 一段(链接带来的视图何时生效、何时失效)、`StudioItemHeader.tsx` 的 `readableTitleWidth`(组合标题声明可读宽度)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.listViewSwitch-27896.test.tsx`,预期 10 passed;或在 Studio 打开 CRM 的「商机」,标题下拉选「商机看板」,地址出现 `&view=crm_opportunity.pipeline`,刷新后仍是看板。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The view switcher is the header's title.** An Interfaces `object` entry's header reads object / view ▾. The view part is the running list's own `ObjectViewTitleSwitcher`, fed the object's list views (the merged `listViews` plus this package's drafts, as the panel picker listed them): rows by label, a search box, and New view, which opens the existing Create View dialog. Studio hands it no ☆, no 📌, no recent views and no Save as my view. It shows when the object has one list view too, so New view stays reachable. On a read-only package it switches views and offers no New view (`canCreate = !readOnly`, as the panel's Add view was gated). New file `ObjectListViewTitle.tsx`; the create path (`createView`, the taken-name toast) moved there unchanged.
- **The panel's picker, Add view and "Back to …" are gone.** The panel keeps the open view's settings. Its title is the view's name exactly as the switcher gives it (`listViewNameOf`: the served `listViews` label first, else the item's own), so the CRM kanban's panel reads 商机看板 like the switcher, not the raw `Pipeline (Kanban)`. A label-less view is "Default view" or its key; the object's name moved to the header's prefix.
- **The open view is in the address.** `?surface=object:OBJECT&nav=NAV&view=OBJECT.KEY`, written only while a view other than the entry's own is open. `useSurfaceDeepLink` is split into its capture and mirror halves (the composed hook is unchanged for the other pillars), so the Interfaces pillar writes the leaf and its view in one replace. `useObjectListViewDraft` takes `initialView`: shown once the linked leaf opens, dropped as soon as another leaf opens or the author picks a view, and taken only for a view of the open object. A pending edit is still sent before the switch (`switchListView`, unchanged), and a held edit still asks.
- **`ObjectViewTitleSwitcher`: the pin is optional.** `pinnedViewId`, `onPinnedViewChange` and `recentViewIds` may be left out; without `onPinnedViewChange` no row draws 📌 and no Pinned section shows. The running list passes all three, so its behaviour is unchanged (its existing pins stay green, and a new pin holds both directions).
- **The title keeps its view name on a narrow row** (measured, see Verification). A composed title shrinks inside its box instead of overflowing, so #29693's fold never saw it as cut: at 1280 on the read-only CRM it showed `Op… / Pipeline (K…` with room to spare in the labelled actions. The title now declares its whole width (`data-studio-title-readable`, read by `readableTitleWidth`) and carries a zero-height sizer whose text is a pseudo-element (no reader or tooltip reads it twice), and "Open in Data" folds to its glyph like the other labelled actions. Order on a narrow row: chips and tools fold, then the object prefix truncates (down to 1.5em), then the view name, with its whole text in the trigger's tooltip.
- **Strings (`@object-ui/i18n` studio namespace):** adds `engine.studio.inspector.listView.defaultView`; removes `defaultTitle`, `namedTitle`, `addView`, `backToEntry`, `switchView`, `switchViewDraft`, which only the removed panel controls read. The switcher's own words (搜索视图, 新建视图) are the console's existing `view.*` keys.

## Tests

All on head `ba9af0941`.

<details><summary>Affected suites: 140 files, 1843 passed</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over every studio-design test that reads the Interfaces header, the list-view panel or the deep link (40 files), the switcher's own tests and the running list's switcher pins (`objectViewTitleSwitcher.test.tsx`, `objectViewTitleSwitcher.phoneWidth-29074`, `ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594`, `ObjectView.starredView-27594`, `ObjectView.personalViews-29635`) and `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 140 passed (140) · Tests 1843 passed | 13 skipped`. Typecheck: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (both programs).

</details>

<details><summary>New and rewritten pins</summary>

- `StudioDesignSurface.listViewSwitch-27896.test.tsx` (rewritten onto the header switcher, 10 tests): the switcher lists all three views by label, the panel title is the same name, no ☆ / 📌 / recent / Save as my view, New view and search present; the panel holds no picker, Add view or Back; a drafted view's edit saves to that view; a pending edit is sent before the switch with no prompt; a held edit asks, declined stays, accepted switches; one list view still shows the switcher with New view; a read-only package switches and offers no New view; a pick writes `?view=` and the entry's view writes none; a link carrying `view` opens that view (a drafted one); CONTROL: a link naming another object's view is not taken.
- `ObjectListViewInspector.addView-27836.test.tsx`: New view from the switcher creates the kanban and the calendar, refuses a taken name; the switcher lists the new view and picking the entry's view shows it again.
- `objectViewTitleSwitcher.test.tsx`: new top-level describe — without the pin door no row draws 📌 and a handed pinned id draws no Pinned section; a row still switches.
- `useSurfaceDeepLink.test.ts`: `view` parses beside `surface` and `nav`, back-compat without it, `view` alone names nothing.
- `ObjectListViewInspector.displayTitle-13151`, `StudioDesignSurface.listViewInspector-11823`, `InterfacesPillar.customize-28562`: expectations moved to the view-only title and to the switcher's New view.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour, restored and proven by blob hash)</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the suites import `src` directly, so no build sits in the path.

- Mirror passes `null` for the view: `a pick writes ?view=` and `a link carrying the view` go red (2 failed / 8 passed); restored blob `b26a265eff49` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, 10/10 again.
- `initialView: null`: `a link carrying the view` goes red (1 failed / 9 passed); restored == HEAD.
- Pin always drawn: `no row draws 📌` goes red (1 failed / 14 passed); restored == HEAD.

The first run of the mirror ablation turned only one pin red: the link pin read the address before the mirror's write landed. The pin now waits for the writes to land, and the re-run turned both red.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope 6–8 are not in this PR.** The size reading: this PR is 1059 changed lines (712 + / 347 −, 16 files) for Scope 1–5. Scope 6 means folding 条件格式化 (with its CEL verdict wired into the list buffer's autosave hold) and the spec-form sections into the list panel, and sending `surface=view:` for a list view to the object page, including for an object no nav entry opens. Scope 7 is the 不在导航中 filter (a draft header carries no body, so the view's kind and object are known only from published rows or the name). Scope 8 is readable form-view names, a heading that says what remains, and the form 视图类型. Together they are an estimated 600–800 more lines with their pins. Also, the 视图类型 fix lives in `metadata-admin/inspectors/ViewVariantInspector.tsx` (its type options come from the list-variant enum, so a form's `simple` reads 未找到), which is outside this claim's file surface.
- **The header-width table on the card does not hold on the read-only CRM.** With Customize, 只读 and Open in Data in the row, the title's room at 1280 is about 208 px, not ≥ 222 px. Before the fold fix the title clipped at 1280 too. After it, 1280 shows both names whole, and 1024 folds the tools and keeps the view name (`Pipeline (Kanban)` / 商机看板) whole with the object prefix cut.
- **Seen, not fixed (pre-existing, not changed here):** on a draft-only object, an entry with no `viewName` opens `OBJECT.default` even when the package drafts an `isDefault` view, because the entry's view is resolved from the shell's merged `listViews` only. The switcher therefore lists "Default view" beside the drafted default, and Create View seeds no columns there. Both behaved the same with the old panel picker. Reported to the seat.
- No spec, server or metadata change, and no new metadata key.

## Verification

Browser, latest `main` + this branch, isolated stack (CRM `--fresh` backend on its own port, Console dev server pointed at it, Chromium from `/opt/pw-browsers`). The screenshots are in the session's scratchpad. They are not attached here because the relay carries no uploads.

<details><summary>Read-only package (com.example.crm), en and zh, 1280 and 1024</summary>

- 1280, 商机: title `商机 / 全部商机 ▾`; the dropdown lists 全部商机, 商机看板; picking 商机看板 writes `&view=crm_opportunity.pipeline`; reload keeps it; the panel title reads 商机看板.
- 1280, en: `Opportunities / Pipeline (Kanban) ▾`, both whole (title 315 px).
- 1024, en: tools folded to glyphs, `Op… / Pipeline (Kanban) ▾`, view name whole (label 151 px, not cut).
- 1024, zh: `商机 / 商机看板 ▾`, both whole.
- No New view in the dropdown; the panel's controls stay disabled.

</details>

<details><summary>Writable package (a fresh package with one object entry)</summary>

- New view from the dropdown, named "Open opportunities this quarter": saved to the package draft, the URL gains `&view=…open_opportunities_this_quarter`, the panel and the title show it.
- Switch to another view and back: the dropdown lists the new view.
- Reload: the same view opens. A shared link opened in a second tab at 1024 opens the same view: chips folded, the long name truncated with its whole text in the trigger's tooltip.
- The pending-edit-before-switch path was not driven in the browser (the drafted object's new view had no column to remove). It is pinned by `a pending edit is sent to its own view before the switch, and nothing asks`.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates (on ba9af0941)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 35 families; each was run and exited 0, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` included (`0 raw tsc error(s) total`) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (172 files, 4985 passed). `--ran` reconciliation: `35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0; eslint over the changed files: 0 errors. Repo-wide scans and the full UI test battery are CI's.

</details>
